## Names

<a id="shape_buffer3_part8"></a>
### [`shape_buffer3_part8`](../../../src/figure_sprites_c900.asm#L6) `$C900-$C93F`

*variable*

Last block of shape buffer 3 (VIC pointer $24). M.SHAPES loads 64 bytes of uninitialised RAM here, and the shape builder overwrites them.

<a id="figure_head_old_a"></a>
### [`figure_head_old_a`](../../../src/figure_sprites_c900.asm#L28) `$C940-$C97F`

*data*

Unused block (pointer/part $25): a head, 12 pixels wide. It differs from the head at $d140 in 12 bits only, so one of the two is an older version. No table names $25 in the second set.

<a id="figure_f68_parts"></a>
### [`figure_f68_parts`](../../../src/figure_sprites_c900.asm#L34) `$C980-$CA3F`

*data*

Second set, parts $26-$28: slots top left, middle left and bottom left of frame 68 with shape_page_offset $40 (block $c000 + part*64). Frames 67-71 build a small standing figure. No animation script uses frames 67-71, so v1 never shows it.

<a id="figure_f69_parts"></a>
### [`figure_f69_parts`](../../../src/figure_sprites_c900.asm#L100) `$CA40-$CB7F`

*data*

Second set, parts $29-$2d: frame 69 of the small figure (slots top left, middle left, middle, bottom left, bottom middle).

<a id="figure_box_unused"></a>
### [`figure_box_unused`](../../../src/figure_sprites_c900.asm#L209) `$CB80-$CBBF`

*data*

Unused block (pointer $2e): a rectangle, five rows of colour 1 with a colour 2 edge on the left and a colour 2 bottom row.

<a id="figure_staff_unused"></a>
### [`figure_staff_unused`](../../../src/figure_sprites_c900.asm#L215) `$CBC0-$CBFF`

*data*

Unused block (pointer $2f): a thin diagonal stick in colours 1 and 2.
